name: beat
description: Agent-driven BDD workflow using Gherkin feature files. Rhythm for your development: explore → design → plan → apply → verify → archive.

interface.shortDescription: Gherkin-driven BDD workflow: explore → design → plan → apply → verify → archive
interface.longDescription: Beat makes coding agents write Gherkin scenarios before touching code, then drives TDD implementation from those specs. Every scenario gets a test, every test links back to the spec. Use /beat:design to capture behavior, /beat:plan to break it down, /beat:apply to implement with TDD, /beat:verify for unbiased verification, and /beat:archive to promote shipped work to living documentation.
defaultPrompt: Let's design a new feature using Beat.
Walk me through Beat's workflow on this change.
